reviews.t: I did notice hair growth on the part of my ...
reviews.x: I did notice hair growth on the part of my eyebrow where I normally don't want hair. So this product works.  However, this product will not make hair grow where hair has never been before.  It will only moisturize hair follicles that exist and if your hair is thin to begin with, this is what you will get.  Only Latisse seems to grow hair where hair has never been before.  Unfortunately Latisse also changes your eye color permanently.

claims.text: Many reviewers report visible eyelash and/or eyebrow growth after consistent use over weeks to months.
Reviewers frequently praise it as an effective eye makeup remover that also conditions lashes.
Several users note it is gentle and pleasant to use, with no smell, stinging, or blurry vision, and it absorbs by morning.
A few reviewers report negative skin or eye reactions, including breakouts and an eye infection.
Some reviewers note it only moisturizes existing follicles and won't grow hair where none existed, with mixed results on brows.
